title: CmdPal: filter static pages in the background
summary: The fork review loop was resumed, rebased onto the live upstream head, and converged after a fresh Copilot pass. The exact upstream head still lacks five validated correctness fixes for pointer activation, publication cost, deferred secondary activation, force-first selection synchronization, and IsInteractive snapshot invalidation. A current-head review with five requests is drafted and awaits explicit approval.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the explicitly clicked activation target
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the explicitly clicked activation target

**Severity:** `high`

Pointer activation currently routes through the selection command, so a click during background filtering can be deferred without retaining the item that the user actually clicked. When the filter publishes, the pending activation can then run the newly selected item instead of the clicked command. Keep pointer activation separate from selection-based Enter deferral and validate the explicit target after publication.

confidence.rationale: The current view invokes the generated selection command for both pointer paths, and the converged fork added an explicit-target activation path that preserves and validates the clicked item.

proposed_comments.title: Use the hash-assisted collection update
proposed_comments.body:
### Use the hash-assisted collection update

**Severity:** `high`

The two-argument `InPlaceUpdateList` overload performs a forward scan for each newly visible item. For largely disjoint consecutive queries this leaves the publication step with quadratic UI-thread work and many collection notifications, so the typing stall this change is intended to remove can still occur while publishing results. Use the hash-assisted or equivalent linear/bulk update overload for this background-filter publication path.

confidence.rationale: The current call selects the scan-based overload, while the converged fork explicitly switched to the overload that returns the hash/update result and avoids repeated remaining-list scans.

proposed_comments.title: Retry secondary activation after selection hydration
proposed_comments.body:
### Retry secondary activation after selection hydration

**Severity:** `medium`

A confirmed static selection can still have an uninitialized item when Ctrl+Enter is pressed quickly. In that case `SecondaryCommand` is null and this path simply drops the activation, even though the existing hydration callback can replay a targeted pending activation. Queue the specific item when its selection initialization is incomplete so the command is retried after hydration.

confidence.rationale: The current command lookup is immediate and has no pending path for a null secondary command; the fork fix adds a targeted pending activation guarded by SelectionInitialized.

proposed_comments.title: Do not confirm a stale force-first selection
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not confirm a stale force-first selection

**Severity:** `high`

Membership alone is not enough when a force-first refresh reorders overlapping results: the view can report the previous first item while bindings are catching up, and this method then confirms the new filter version and releases deferred Enter against the wrong command. Preserve the force-first expectation through completion and require the selected item to match the current first interactive result before confirming the version.

confidence.rationale: The current predicate accepts any interactive member, while the converged fork tracks the expected first interactive item and rejects a stale renderer selection.

proposed_comments.title: Invalidate static snapshots when interactivity changes
proposed_comments.body:
### Invalidate static snapshots when interactivity changes

**Severity:** `medium`

An item's command or section can change `IsInteractive`, but the static-filter snapshot currently stores only title, subtitle, and error state. The notification handler therefore sees an interaction-only change as unchanged and leaves the expected force-first item stale, which can block deferred Enter indefinitely. Include `IsInteractive` in the snapshot state and refilter when that property changes.

confidence.rationale: The upstream handler and snapshot omit the same property; the converged fork adds it to both paths and the final Copilot review returned zero further comments.
